note: Every rule here is implemented under the same id in schema/semantic_validate.py (RULES); verify_all.py fails if the two sets differ.

rules.rule: Exactly one HERO-category node per page.
rules.evidence: All three templates open with exactly one hero (home-intro, work-head, not-found).

rules.rule: The hero is the first non-SHELL/UTILITY node.
SHELL nodes come before every content node (they are page chrome in DOM order).
A section with constraints.mustBeLast is the last node (contact.details on home).
constraints.onePerPage / maxPerPage respected (keyed on section id).
constraints.requires present on the page (filter island needs the work card list).
A section with constraints.templates appears only in those templates.
Two adjacent content nodes of the same category.

exceptions.why: Case studies chain galleries back to back on 16/18 projects (e.g. arte: stills -> image-row -> large-image).
Real adjacency on every home and work page (got-project prompt directly above the let's talk band).

rules.rule: The same (section, variant) twice in a row.
index.more-works holds exactly 3 cards (measured on all 36 work routes).
At most 4 nodes whose chosen motion is an ambient loop (title-rotate, hint-breathe, word-cycle, marquee, signature-draw).
In reference mode the home template is used only by / and /fr/.
Only SHELL/UTILITY sections may be retrievalEligible:false; a node's retrievalEligible (if given) must equal its contract.
